T: Sledgehammer in the morning. Chilli at night.
D: Newly crowned world champion Adonis Creed is challenged by the son of the man who killed his father in the ring.
P: Serve the snacks when Ivan puts Viktor through his training in Ukraine.
S: fuel for Viktor's training in Ukraine

Grate 800g potatoes and 1 onion, squeeze out the liquid hard and mix with 1 egg, 3 tbsp plain flour, salt and pepper. Fry heaped spoonfuls in 4 tbsp oil for 3 to 4 minutes a side until deep golden and crisp. Serve hot with 200g sour cream and chopped dill.
Adonis rehearses a proposal speech he can't quite get out

Dice 300g sashimi-grade tuna and toss with the juice of 1 lime, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil and sliced spring onion. Brush 8 small corn tortillas with oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Spread the tostadas with mashed avocado, top with the tuna, a little chipotle mayonnaise and 2 tbsp fried shallots.
M: cooked low at the end of a day in the dirt

Brown 800g diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano and 2 tbsp chopped chipotle in adobo, then a 400g tin of tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Simmer covered for 2 hours, add a 400g tin of kidney beans and 20g dark chocolate and simmer 20 minutes more. Serve over 300g steamed rice with sour cream, grated cheddar and spring onion.
Adrian's chicken cacciatore with soft polenta
From Rocky's restaurant in Philly, the one named for Adrian

Chicken thighs braised with tomato, capsicum, olives, rosemary and garlic, over soft parmesan polenta. Brown the chicken in the oil, then lift out. Soften the onion, capsicum and garlic in the pan. Add the tomatoes, olives and rosemary, put the chicken back and simmer covered until tender. Bring the stock to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in the parmesan. Serve with the chicken.
W: layered and patient, like everything the Dragos do

Melt 100g honey, 100g caster sugar and 80g butter over simmering water, whisk in 2 eggs and 1 tsp bicarb until foamy, then work in 350g plain flour. Rest 15 minutes, divide into 6, roll each thin to a 20cm round and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Trim and crumb the offcuts. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 500g sour cream and 100g icing sugar, stack the layers with the cream, cover the cake and the crumbs and chill overnight.
K: the only cold thing for miles around the camp
Blend 1.2kg seedless watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 250ml cold water. Strain, chill and pour over ice with mint sprigs.

dishes.make_ahead: Best fried just before serving; mix the dill sour cream up to 2 days ahead. Keep fried deruny crisp in a 120C oven for up to 30 minutes

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and onion on the coarse side of a grater.
Tip into a clean tea towel and squeeze out as much liquid as you can.
Mix with the egg, flour and plenty of salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry heaped spoonfuls, flattened, for 3 to 4 minutes a side, in batches, until deep golden and crisp. Drain.
Stir half the dill through the sour cream and serve with the hot deruny and the rest of the dill on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the tostadas up to 1 day ahead and keep airtight; mix the chipotle mayonnaise up to 3 days ahead; dress the tuna just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the tortillas with the oil and bake on a tray until crisp, turning once.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Mash the avocado with the juice of half a lime and salt.
Dice the tuna and toss with the juice of 1 lime, the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions.
Spread the tostadas with avocado, top with the tuna, a little chipotle mayonnaise and the fried shallots. Serve with the last lime half in wedges.

veg.n: LA proposal night charred corn tostadas
veg.make_ahead: Bake the tostadas up to 1 day ahead and keep airtight; mix the chipotle mayonnaise up to 3 days ahead; char the corn just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the tortillas with 1 tbsp of the oil and bake on a tray until crisp, turning once.
Cut the kernels off the corn and char in the rest of the oil in a very hot pan. Toss with the beans, the juice of 1 lime, the soy sauce and spring onions.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle. Mash the avocado with the juice of half a lime and salt.
Spread the tostadas with avocado, top with the corn and beans, a little chipotle mayonnaise, the feta and fried shallots. Serve with the last lime half in wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled, or freeze up to 3 months; cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Season the beef with salt and brown well in the oil in batches in a heavy pot. Lift out.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pot.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, oregano and chipotle for 1 minute, then return the beef with the tomatoes and stock. Simmer, covered, on low until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the beans and chocolate and simmer, uncovered, until thick. Meanwhile cook the rice.
Season and serve over the rice with sour cream, cheddar and spring onion.

veg.n: The desert camp sweet potato chilli
veg.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled, or freeze up to 3 months; cook the rice on the night

ingredients.item: tinned kidney and black beans, drained

steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil in a heavy pot.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, oregano and chipotle for 1 minute, then add the sweet potato, tomatoes and stock. Simmer, covered, until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the beans and chocolate and simmer, uncovered, until thick. Meanwhile cook the rice.
Season with salt and serve over the rice with sour cream, cheddar and spring onion.

dishes.n: Adrian's chicken cacciatore with soft polenta
dishes.make_ahead: Braise up to 2 days ahead and reheat; make the polenta on the night

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil, then lift out.
Soften the onion, capsicum and garlic in the pan.
Add the tomatoes, olives and rosemary, put the chicken back and simmer covered until tender.
Bring the stock to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in the parmesan. Serve with the chicken.

veg.n: Adrian's mushroom cacciatore with soft polenta
veg.make_ahead: Braise up to 2 days ahead and reheat; make the polenta on the night

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook until soft.
Add the tomatoes, olives, beans and rosemary and simmer until thick.
Bring the stock to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in the parmesan. Serve with the cacciatore.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble 1 day ahead, the overnight chill is what softens the layers; keeps 3 days in the fridge

steps.text: Melt the honey, caster sugar and butter in a bowl over simmering water.
Whisk in the eggs, then the bicarb, until it foams and turns golden. Off the heat, work in the flour to a soft dough.
Cover and rest until cool enough to handle. Heat the oven to 180C.
Divide into 6, roll each thinly on baking paper, cut to a 20cm round using a plate and bake each for about 6 minutes until golden. Keep the offcuts and bake them too.
Blitz the offcuts to fine crumbs.
Whip the cream to soft peaks, then whisk in the sour cream and icing sugar.
Stack the layers with the cream between each, cover the top and sides and press on the crumbs.
Chill overnight.

dishes.make_ahead: Blend and strain up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; stir before pouring over ice

steps.text: Blend the watermelon, lime juice, sugar and water until smooth.
Strain through a sieve into a jug.
Chill until very cold.
Pour over ice in 4 glasses and add a mint sprig.
